data.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: dd-3 deferred-state alt-DD — If draft-9 in_progress at sprint dispatch time, task-4 is parked deferred AND story closure criterion shifts to: 'deferred-comment exists on epic ticket citing story-blocked dependency on draft-9' (not the dd-3 test passing).
